verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community comment wishing Bitwarden 'brought fingerprint auth to Linux already.' That indirectly suggests biometric unlock exists on other platforms, but nothing in the pack documents app lock on mobile. missing for 10: first-party docs on biometric or PIN unlock for the mobile and Authenticator apps, evidence of auto-lock or timeout behavior, and hands-on corroboration that a borrowed phone cannot show codes.
